description: A follow-up turn that answers three of six questions and adds a deadline. The unblocked requirements are marked (new) and continue the FR sequence, the deadline starts the NFR sequence, FR-001 is unchanged and is not repeated, the answered questions are not asked again, and the three unanswered questions stay open under their own IDs.

must_match.why: Q-001 and Q-002 unblock the closing requirement

must_match.pattern: ^FR-00[23] \(new\): If [^\n]*not valid[^\n]*, then the ticket service shall reject the submission
must_match.why: an accepted proposal is the user's answer, and invalid input is unwanted: If ... then

must_match.pattern: ^NFR-001 \(new\): [^\n]*the ticket service shall email[^\n]*within 1 minute of the submission
must_match.why: the deadline is a threshold on FR-001's response: a new NFR, the first in its own sequence
an unanswered question stays open under its own ID
an unanswered question stays open under its own ID
an unanswered question stays open under its own ID

must_not_match.why: every requirement in a follow-up reply is marked (new) or (changed)
the deadline does not change FR-001: an unchanged requirement is not returned
answered questions are closed, not asked again
the deadline is an NFR, not part of an FR
